Title: Login with MFA
Steps: Log in as HR Manager with valid password; enter valid OTP, then repeat with wrong OTP.
Expected: Valid OTP -> dashboard; wrong OTP -> 'Invalid code', no session.

Title: Department scoping
Steps: As Sales Dept Manager call GET /analytics/attrition?dept=Finance.

Title: Configure organization
Steps: HR Admin adds dept 'R&D', reason 'Relocation', threshold 4 %.
Expected: Values saved and appear in forms; threshold used for alerts.

Title: Employee CRUD
Steps: Create employee E1001; edit designation; create duplicate E1001.
Expected: Create/update succeed; duplicate rejected with error.

Title: CSV bulk import
Steps: Upload CSV with 1,000 rows of which 3 have invalid dates.
Expected: 997 rows imported; error report lists the 3 rows.

Title: HRMS nightly sync
Steps: Change a record in the HRMS sandbox stub; run sync job.
Notes: Runs against the sandbox HRMS stub; no real HRMS is available.

Title: Headcount snapshot
Steps: Run month-start job on seeded data.
Expected: Snapshot rows created per department with correct counts.

Title: Record resignation
Steps: Record voluntary resignation for E1001, reason 'Better pay', regretted.
Expected: 201 Created; status 'Notice period'; audit entry written.

Title: Invalid separation dates
Steps: Last working day 01-10-2026 before resignation date 15-10-2026.
Expected: 400 with field error; no record created.

Title: Clearance checklist
Steps: Tick 4 of 5 clearance items and close; tick the last item and close.
Expected: First close refused naming the pending item; second succeeds. Closing also needs the last working day to have passed.

Title: Withdraw resignation
Steps: Withdraw a resignation during the notice period.
Expected: Shown as Retained; employee active; attrition unchanged.

Title: Survey email
Steps: Record separation; run the send job; inspect the recording mail gateway.
Expected: One email with tokenised link within 5 min.

Title: Submit survey once
Steps: Submit survey via link; reuse link; use 31-day-old token.
Expected: First accepted; reuse and expired token rejected.

Title: Survey reminders
Steps: Leave survey unsubmitted; advance clock 9 days.

Title: Attrition rate formula
Steps: Seed 12 separations, opening HC 236, closing HC 244 for Q3.

Title: Breakdowns
Steps: View breakdown by department and tenure band for 2026.
Expected: Sum of each breakdown equals overall separations.

Title: Trend chart
Steps: Open 12-month trend.
Expected: 12 monthly points per year; values match monthly rates.

Title: Exit reasons ranking
Steps: Seed reasons: pay 6, growth 4, manager 2.

Title: Early attrition
Steps: Seed 3 leavers with tenure < 12 months out of 10.

Title: Risk score & band
Steps: Run weekly scoring job on seeded employees.
Expected: Every active employee scored 0-100; bands match thresholds.

Title: Risk factors
Steps: Open risk card of a High-risk employee.

Title: Retention action
Steps: Log 'career discussion' due tomorrow; advance clock 2 days.

Title: Threshold alert
Steps: Set threshold 4 %; seed Sales 3-month rate 6 %.
Expected: One alert in-app + email to HR and Sales manager.

Title: Export PDF/CSV
Steps: Export filtered dashboard.
Expected: PDF and CSV figures equal on-screen values.
Notes: CSV figures checked against the dashboard API. PDF is the browser's print of the same page, checked by hand.

Title: Scheduled report
Steps: Subscribe user; advance clock to 2nd of month.

Title: Dashboard response time
Steps: Load script (docs/perf/load_test.py): 50k employees, 5 years of data, 50 users.
Expected: p95 dashboard <= 3 s; API p95 <= 500 ms.
Notes: Dashboard passes (p95 0.5 s at 50 users); other API calls fail (p95 3.7 s against 0.5 s) because the separations list is not paged.

Title: Concurrency
Steps: Load script: 200 concurrent users on one organization.
Notes: No slowdown and no errors at 200 concurrent users, but in one organization instead of ten.

Title: Backup & restore
Steps: Restore last nightly backup to staging.
Notes: No deployed environment or backup job, and no backlog item covers AAS-NF-003.

Title: Accessibility & task time
Steps: axe scan of all pages; 5 users record a separation.
Expected: No WCAG AA violations; >= 4 users finish < 3 min.
Notes: Not run; no backlog item covers AAS-NF-004.

Title: Cross-browser
Steps: Run smoke suite on Chrome, Edge, Firefox (2 versions each).
Notes: Not run; no backlog item covers AAS-NF-006.

Title: Coverage gate
Steps: Run the test suite with JaCoCo.
Notes: Measured by the report; CI does not fail the build on it yet.

Title: TLS configuration
Steps: Check the HSTS header; run testssl.sh once a deployed environment exists.
Notes: HSTS header tested. No TLS scan: there is no deployed HTTPS environment yet.

Title: Password storage & lockout
Steps: Inspect users table; 6 wrong logins.

Title: Encryption at rest
Steps: Query employee table directly in DB.
Notes: Email, gender and survey comments are ciphertext in the database. Names are not encrypted (see DEVIATIONS.md).

Title: Tenant isolation (IDOR)
Steps: Org A token requests Org B employee/separation IDs.

Title: Audit trail
Steps: Record a separation; read the audit log table.
Expected: Audit entry created; no API can change it (none exposes it).

Title: Data retention
Steps: Run anonymisation job with records older than 7 years.
Notes: No retention job exists, and no backlog item covers AAS-NF-007.

Title: Survey anonymity threshold
Steps: Manager views survey results for a team with 3 responses.

Title: Injection & XSS
Steps: OWASP ZAP active scan; import CSV with '=HYPERLINK(...)'.
Notes: CSV formula injection tested. OWASP ZAP scan not run yet (AAS-36).

Title: Session expiry
Steps: Idle 31 min; reuse token after logout.
Notes: Token rejected after logout and 30-minute lifetime tested; a real 31-minute idle wait is not.
